desc: Parse the input to build the functional graph where each node $i$ has an edge to $A_i$.
Decompose the graph into connected components, identifying the unique cycle and the trees rooted on the cycle nodes for each component.
For each component, calculate the size of the tree attached to each cycle node.
Implement the logic to compute the number of valid assignments for a component by iterating through values $v$ and using combinations.
Run the code against Sample 1, Sample 2, and Sample 3 to verify correctness.
If outputs do not match, debug and fix the implementation.
